reviews.title: A functional motherboard, buy something else if yo
reviews.comment: This is a decent motherboard, but it is extraordinarily twitchy about detecting RAM. I had two types of RAM that were both on the compatibility list for this motherboard, and I lost half my capacity because it didn't actually like my T-Force Delta RAM versus my Corsair vengeance. So basically I got dropped from 64 GB of RAM to 32 GB of RAM. This was very strange to me because my original motherboard was also an MSI in the same series. Basically I couldn't trust this motherboards compatibility list, I would not buy it again. It also has an extraordinary failure in the ethernet port as well, go look that up you'll find it. To make a long story a little shorter, I would not buy this motherboard again, and it has me questioning whether I will ever buy MSI's equipment again
